note: M02h4 (DL-741): the tree form class of the TREE byte. The bake (S3) matches the lowercased genus (the first word of the botanical name) of a DataSF street tree (`species`, `Genus species :: Common name`) or an OSM natural=tree (`species`, then `genus`, then leaf_type=needleleaved as conifer) against `genus`; an unmatched name takes a hash-keyed split, `planeShare` Plane and the rest Ficus. Rows beyond the milestone's eleven were tuned from the genus counts of the sf raw snapshot (tkzw-k3nq.jsonl, 144,519 rows, read 2026-11-01). `forms.*.heightM` is the triangular [min, mode, max] of the mesher's height draw, in metres; `asset` (absent) may later name an AssetRef for a near LOD. M02h5: `shrub` and `hedge` are the understory forms of the scatter (bytes 5 and 6); `skipSpecies` drops DataSF rows whose lowercased genus or whole name is listed: planting sites and stumps are no tree (2,117 rows of the sf snapshot, tuned from M02h4 treeUnmatched). Design values.
